text: So what does a model router actually do?
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: It picks the right model for each task.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: And so a task request comes in and a router has a classifier model and then a prompt with some criteria that help it decide what model would be most appropriate for a given task.
